blocks.text: To enable the HTTP Header Control feature, contact Zscaler Support.
The HTTP header profile allows you to create criteria for various HTTP request headers. It consists of adding HTTP header profiles and associating them to a URL Filtering policy rule.
The HTTP header profile provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create policies based on client request headers.
Modify request headers in the egress traffic for tenant control.

blocks.heading: About the HTTP Header Profile Page

blocks.text: On the HTTP Header Profile page (Internet Access > Policy > HTTP Header Control > HTTP Header Profile), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a configured HTTP header profile.
Modify the column option to view the HTTP header profiles accordingly.
View a list of all the configured HTTP header profiles. For each HTTP header profile, you can see:
Name: The name of the HTTP header profile that is displayed when configuring a policy rule.
Criteria: The criteria (i.e., Origin, Referer, and User Agent) of the HTTP header profile.
Description: The description of the HTTP header profile if available.
Edit or delete an HTTP header profile.
View the HTTP Header Insertion Profile page.
